question: Does the surrounding text template change the baseline relationship with human semantic closeness?
fixed_inputs: All 239 icons, the same 231 distinct published labels in the same order, human measurements, checkpoint, preprocessing, seed, CPU float32, image and text batches of 10
primary: Spearman correlation of intended-label cosine similarity with human semantic_distance (higher means closer)
comparison: Each new correlation minus baseline; paired icon bootstrap, 2000 samples, seed 20261024, percentile 95% interval
secondary: Number of icons whose highest-scoring label changes
interpretation: Exploratory sensitivity analysis; report all three variants without selecting a winning template as a validated model. No synonyms, label edits, or per-icon template selection.
